name: Superhuman
summary: Fast email client. Premium dark UI, keyboard-first, purple glow
description: An inspired interpretation of Superhumon's design language — a fast-email productivity brand split between an editorial dark hero (deep indigo navy with violet-sky atmospheric backdrop and a portrait subject) and a quiet white content body with off-warm-grey ink. The system uses a single proprietary variable display sans, heavy weight 460–540 with tight tracking, and a deep-teal closing CTA band that breaks the indigo/white rhythm with a warm dark interlude. Buttons are tight rounded rectangles, pricing is sober and dense, and the brand reads more like a high-end newsletter than a SaaS app.

colors.name: Primary Indigo Navy
colors.role: The brand's primary surface and CTA color. Hero canvas, filled rounded-rectangle button, featured pricing tier.

colors.name: Indigo Deep
colors.role: Pressed-state lift / deeper navy used in hero gradient stops.

colors.name: Surface Violet Soft
colors.role: The hero pill-button fill — pale violet over the indigo canvas. Also appears in atmospheric backdrops.

colors.name: Surface Teal Deep
colors.role: The signature closing-CTA band color. Rich green-blue, almost black.

colors.name: Surface Teal Mid
colors.role: Slightly lifted teal for nested chrome inside the band.

colors.name: Canvas Soft
colors.role: Barely-warm off-white for alternating feature-row bands.

colors.name: Ink
colors.role: Default body text. Warm dark grey, never pure black.

colors.name: On Primary
colors.role: Text on dark navy / teal surfaces.

substitutesNote: **Inter Variable** (open-source via Google Fonts) is the recommended substitute. Set `font-variation-settings: "wght" 540` for display, 460 for body — Inter's variable axes match. Avoid fixed-weight Inter; the in-between weights are the brand's signature.
